crossRefs.note: My face is red with weeping. Deep darkness is on my eyelids.
My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.
Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.
For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted…
For this our heart is faint. For these things our eyes are dim.
My days are past. My plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.
I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.
For who knows what is good for man in life, all the days of his vain life which he spends like a shadow? For who can…

translations.web: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.
translations.bsb: My eyes have grown dim with grief, and my whole body is but a shadow.
translations.kjv: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members are as a shadow.
translations.asv: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, And all my members are as a shadow.
